vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: cellcog
Version: 1.0.6

The skill is designed to send user-specified local files (via the `<SHOW_FILE>` directive) and prompts to an external, third-party API endpoint at `https://cellcog.ai`. While this is the stated purpose of the skill, the broad capability to read arbitrary local files and transmit them to an external service, combined with the handling of an API key for this service, introduces a significant data exfiltration risk. This behavior, found primarily in `SKILL.md`, is considered suspicious due to the inherent risk of sensitive data exposure, even without explicit malicious instructions within the skill itself.
